title: PickupFailureRecord
description: One row appended to <workspace>/logs/pickup-failures.jsonl. Two row shapes share the file, disambiguated by the 'kind' field: 'pickup-failed' (the per-project pickup loop dead-letters a 3-progress folder; the strict-iteration pickup walks every 3-progress folder oldest-first by mtime before considering 2-ready, and a folder whose run finished without producing a CLI output line for several attempts in a row is unrecoverable and gets surfaced loudly in 3a-failed-pickup/<slug>-pickup-failed-<utc-date>/ - ADR-0028: pickup failures are loud, never silently archived) and 'pickup-restored' (an operator restored a folder from 3a-failed-pickup back into a live lane via POST /api/jobs/{id}/restore-from-failed-pickup). The two-row trail makes the dead-letter -> restore lifecycle reviewable per-slug.

at.description: UTC timestamp at which the dead-letter move happened.

kind.description: Dead-letter row. The pickup loop gave up on a 3-progress folder.

projectName.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

slug.description: Original folder slug under 3-progress at the time of the dead-letter.

jobId.description: Job id read from job.json when present; usually equal to the folder slug. Null when the folder lacked a parseable job.json.

destinationSlug.description: Slug under 3a-failed-pickup after the dead-letter move (ADR-0028). Format: '<original>-pickup-failed-<yyyy-mm-dd>', with a numeric suffix on collisions.

attempts.description: Number of consecutive autopickup runs that finished without producing a CLI output line before the dead-letter fired.

threshold.description: Configured maximum-attempts threshold (default 3). Attempts at or above this trigger the dead-letter.

outputDeadlineSeconds.description: Configured per-attempt output deadline in seconds (default 60). Each attempt counts as failed when no CLI output line arrives within this window after spawn.

attemptHistory.description: Per-attempt diagnostics (most recent last) recorded since the runner last reset the counter for this slug. Bounded by <threshold>; older entries are dropped.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the dead-letter; surfaces in the structured backend log line and in the chat-log note dropped on the archived folder.

at.description: UTC timestamp at which the restore happened.

kind.description: Restore row. An operator lifted a folder from 3a-failed-pickup back into a live lane.

projectName.description: Project name (same shape as on the pickup-failed row).

slug.description: Original (pre-dead-letter) slug. Matches the 'slug' field on the corresponding pickup-failed row so a per-slug history is reconstructable.

sourceSlug.description: Slug the folder lived under in 3a-failed-pickup before the restore. Format: '<original>-pickup-failed-<yyyy-mm-dd>' (with optional numeric collision suffix).

restoredAs.description: Slug the folder now lives under in the target lane. Equal to 'slug' unless 'keepDeadLetterSlug=true' was passed on the restore call, in which case it equals 'sourceSlug'.

targetState.description: Lane the folder was restored into. Today always '2-ready'; encoded as a free-form string so future restore targets do not require a schema change.
